aboutHtml:
Tony and Kirsten Morris have run STIHL SHOP Gisborne since 2020. We're locals through and through, serving homeowners, farmers, contractors and businesses across the district. We're proud to support our community, with new local giveback initiatives coming soon.

We stock STIHL, Masport, Cub Cadet, Rover, Honda Power Equipment, Hansa Chippers, Lawnmaster, Wrights Stander and more. Our fully equipped service workshop and factory-trained STIHL technicians handle everything from routine maintenance to major repairs, using genuine parts. We service and repair all major brands, not just STIHL.

Pop in to see our range of battery-powered equipment, from hedge cutters to chainsaws, or discuss what suits your needs. We offer home delivery and click and collect for online orders. We're open seven days a week.
